description: Calculates the pixels an image needs for a 4OVER4 print at a given size and DPI; use it when someone asks whether an image is large enough to print. For bleed use calculate_print_bleed; for one product's full file setup use get_print_file_setup. Requires width and height in inches; DPI defaults to 300. Returns the pixel width and height. Customer phrases: "what pixel size for a 4x6 at 300 DPI", "is 1024x768 enough for a 5x7 print".

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch. Default 300.

name: calculate_print_resolution
